name: apk-audit
description: Batch audit and compare APK files: decompile each APK, extract key info (package, version, channel_adver, google_client_id, app_name, permissions, SDK versions), generate HTML + Markdown comparison report.

inputs.name: apk_paths
inputs.description: Comma-separated APK file paths, or a directory containing APK files.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: JSON summary with audit results and report paths (from script stdout).
